# Google Gemini Enterprise / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform — captured 2026-08-14
# sources.json still points at cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/release-notes (stale — Workbench
# image bumps only). Two canonical streams, NEITHER in sources.json:
#   A) https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/release-notes           (renders fully)
#   B) https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/release-notes (nav-only)

## Stream A — Gemini Enterprise release notes — ADVANCED from Aug 7 to Aug 13

### August 13, 2026  [Skills reported 2026-08-14]
- **Skills** — users can **create, upload and share skills**: reusable custom instructions that let
  the assistant handle specialized tasks. Administrators control availability through **Feature
  Management** settings ("Enable skills" toggle). Corroborating docs describe it as **GA with an
  allowlist** — the Google Cloud project must be added by the account manager before the admin page
  is reachable.
- Gemini 3.7 Flash GA across global, US and EU regions, behind a console feature toggle; not in the
  mobile app.  [model availability — below bar]

### August 12, 2026
- **GitHub connector with Data Federation — GA**  [reported 2026-08-14]. Search and ACT on
  repositories, issues and pull requests from the agent. Write actions include **create branch, add
  comment to an issue, add comment to a pending review, update pull request, merge pull request,
  create or update file, push file, fork repository, update issues**. Data federation sends the
  search query **directly to the GitHub API** at query time and blends results with other connected
  sources (rather than indexing into a data store).
- **AlphaEvolve HPC solution** — distributed, containerized infrastructure for large-scale
  evolutionary code-optimization experiments that exceed single-machine limits.

### August 11, 2026  [connector expansion reported 2026-08-14]
- **12 new data stores in public preview**: Cisco Workspaces, Fibery, Gong, Guru, Hex, LegalZoom,
  Mercury, Miro, Ramp, Solve Intelligence, **Vanta**, Webex Meetings — natural-language search and
  read operations.
- **New write actions on existing connectors**: Airtable record updates; Hex threads; Miro document
  creation; Smartsheet row additions.
- Overage management for invoiced Cloud Billing accounts.  [billing — not reported]

### August 10, 2026
- CSV export of user data reaches GA.  [admin convenience — below bar]

### August 7 and earlier  (all reported 2026-08-09)
Custom MCP server data stores GA (off by default, org-policy constraint, auth none or OAuth 2.0,
HTTPS + StreamableHTTP, importable from the Agent Registry); automatic `tools/list` tool discovery
(Aug 6); `execute_tool` + `invoke_connector` trace spans (Aug 4); 17 new connectors (Aug 3).

## Stream B — Agent Platform release notes (nav-only via WebFetch; recovered via WebSearch)
- **Gemini Omni Flash** — new video model (generates clips from text/image/video/audio references,
  edits scenes) now available on the Agent Platform.  [model availability — below bar]
- AlphaEvolve GA and the Feedback service preview: unchanged, both reported 2026-08-07.
- Grok 4.1 family deprecated, shutdown August 20, 2026.  [deprecation]
- No net-new Agent Platform governance/agent capability this scan.

Updated: 2026-08-14 — Stream A advanced by four dated entries (Aug 10-13); three reported.
Neither canonical URL is in sources.json (outstanding since 2026-07-08).
